scope: ephemeral two-host HTTPS research probe; not independent validation
capture_notes: Initial write of this evidence file failed because the nested evidence directory did not exist; the directory was created and the same content was retried.
The witness host did not expose PowerShell Get-FileHash in this session; SHA-256 file hashes were computed with Python hashlib instead.
No firewall rule was added for the probe.
limitations: Both computers remain under the same operator and are not an independent validation arrangement.
The authorized client credential can advance the remote counter and could cause fail-closed denial of service if compromised.
Witness-host compromise, disk rollback, certificate/key compromise, availability loss, and independent key governance are not solved.
The test establishes bounded off-host monotonic witness behavior only; it does not establish live containment, scientific efficacy, parity, or high assurance.
